answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. The copper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The ridge lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the oasis is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
